flyer.justification: The flyer title exceeds the 6-word limit by one word, but otherwise follows all layout and content guidelines.

summary.justification: Well-structured executive briefing adhering to markdown and word count requirements.

instagram.justification: Includes all required elements including visual carousel cues, call to action, and 12 targeted hashtags.

linkedin.justification: Failed to include the required 3-5 targeted hashtags and adopts a first-person speaker persona conflicting with the author profile.

newsletter.justification: Adheres well to format requirements, though it misattributes a direct quote from the speaker to the EventAI Research Team.

blog.justification: Misses format requirements for numbered sections and a comparison/takeaway table, while writing in first person from the speaker's perspective.
